q.en: True or false: the overview should include exact percentages.
q.bn: সত্য না মিথ্যা: overview-এ exact percentage থাকা উচিত।

options.en: True
False
Only for pie charts
Only in the second sentence

why.en: Exact figures belong in the body paragraphs; the overview uses comparative language (highest, lowest) instead.
why.bn: Exact figure body paragraph-এ থাকে; overview comparative language (highest, lowest) ব্যবহার করে।

q.en: Where does the overview go in the four-paragraph structure?

options.en: At the very end, as a conclusion
Right after the paraphrased introduction, before the body paragraphs
options.bn: Paraphrased introduction-এর ঠিক পরে, body paragraph-এর আগে

options.en: Inside body paragraph 2
It can go anywhere

why.en: The overview comes right after the introduction, before any detailed body paragraphs.
why.bn: Overview introduction-এর ঠিক পরে আসে, detailed body paragraph-এর আগে।

q.en: Fix: "Overall, this is a worrying trend."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "Overall, this is a worrying trend."

options.en: Overall, the data show a clear upward trend.
options.bn: Overall, the data show a clear upward trend.

options.en: Overall, I am worried about this trend.
options.bn: Overall, I am worried about this trend.

options.en: Overall, this trend is bad for everyone.
options.bn: Overall, this trend is bad for everyone.

options.en: Overall, this is a worrying trend indeed.
options.bn: Overall, this is a worrying trend indeed.

why.en: The overview must stay objective — "worrying" is a personal opinion, which has no place in Task 1.
why.bn: Overview অবশ্যই objective হতে হবে — "worrying" একটা personal opinion, Task 1-এ এটার জায়গা নেই।

q.en: What is the minimum band that specifically mentions the overview requirement?
q.bn: Overview requirement নির্দিষ্টভাবে উল্লেখ করা minimum band কোনটা?

options.en: Band 4
Band 5
Band 6
Band 9

why.en: Band 6 requires a relevant overview to be attempted; Band 7 requires it to be clear.
why.bn: Band 6-এ একটা relevant overview attempt করা লাগে; Band 7-এ clear overview লাগে।

q.en: If a graph has six lines, what should the overview do?
q.bn: একটা graph-এ যদি ছয়টা line থাকে, overview-তে কী করা উচিত?

options.en: Describe all six lines individually in detail
options.bn: সব ছয়টা line আলাদা আলাদা detail-এ বর্ণনা করা

options.en: Group similar lines together and mention only the biggest-picture pattern or exception
options.bn: একইরকম line গুলো group করে শুধু সবচেয়ে বড় picture-এর pattern বা exception উল্লেখ করা

options.en: Pick only one line and ignore the rest
options.bn: শুধু একটা line বেছে বাকি গুলো ignore করা

options.en: List all six lines' exact final values
options.bn: ছয়টা line-এর exact final value list করা

why.en: The overview groups similar data and highlights the 2-3 biggest-picture features, not every individual category.
why.bn: Overview একইরকম data group করে এবং ২-৩টা সবচেয়ে বড় picture-এর feature highlight করে, প্রতিটা category আলাদা করে না।
